info.title: Ficcado CRM & Inventory Management API
info.description: Authoritative OpenAPI 3 Specification for Ficcado CRM. Governs sales lifecycle, inventory deduction, warehouse allocation, customer relationship management, audit logs, and product reviews.

get.summary: Get sale by ID with IDOR ownership validation

put.summary: Update sale (only allowed if not locked)
Update ticket fields (verification status, refund amount, disposition, etc.)
Reorder images — supply full ordered list of image IDs
Manually adjust total quantity (stock count correction)

get.summary: Get admin by ID (SUPERADMIN or self)

post.summary: Create warehouse allocation (with unallocated-balance cap check)

get.summary: List all vendors with contact numbers

post.summary: Create vendor
Record a payment to a vendor

get.summary: List all sales (supports optional keyset pagination)

post.summary: Create a new sale
Request replacement — locks the sale
Request return/refund — locks the sale
Open a return/refund ticket for a locked sale
Close ticket — enforces validation gate, handles disposition, unlocks sale
Create replacement request from a locked sale
Complete replacement — deducts new stock, handles disposition, unlocks sale
Submit a review via tokenized link (no auth required)

get.summary: List all notes (most recently updated first)

post.summary: Create a note
Create item

get.summary: List all images for an item, ordered by display_order

post.summary: Upload a new image for an item (generates full + thumbnail in R2)
Add or update an inventory record (item + size + quantity)
Create expense
Manually log a damaged product
Admin logout — per-device: revokes this session's JWT only, clears cookie
Admin login — email only — sets httpOnly JWT cookie
Create admin (SUPERADMIN only)

get.summary: Get allocations for a specific handler admin
Get narrative audit log for a sale by ID
Search sales by invoice, customer name, or phone number
Get all reviews for an item (authenticated CRM view)
Calculate profitability for a given period (daily/weekly/monthly/custom) [SUPERADMIN only]
Validate a review token (no auth required)
Sales log entries for a specific invoice number
Inventory history for a specific item
Inventory history related to a specific invoice
List active items with sizes (for sale dropdowns)
Get unallocated quantity for an item+size (warehouse allocation cap check)
Phone-number autofill lookup for sale creation modal

delete.summary: Delete a specific image (removes from R2 and database)

cookieAuth.description: Session JWT transmitted via httpOnly cookie 'ficcado_session'
cookieAuth.name: ficcado_session
